### Headline summary
- Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO amid legal and political scrutiny, with Colette Kress named interim CEO. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p48#a261111p48), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/nvidia-stock-drops-jensen-huang-second-affair-report-2026-11))
- The US Commerce Department is finalizing a rule to prevent Chinese AI firms from remotely accessing US chips and to block chip smuggling. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/commerce-department-finalizing-long-awaited-ai-remote-access-rule), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p53#a261111p53))
- UK-based AI chip startup Fractile raised $720 million in a Series C round at a $7 billion valuation to develop faster inference hardware. ([Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/start-ups/uk-ai-chips-start-up-fractile-raises-720m-at-7bn-valuation), [Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/uk-ai-chip-start-up-fractile-raises-720m-at-7bn-valuation))

### Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid legal and political scrutiny
Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, with Colette Kress named interim CEO and the board seeking a permanent replacement. The departure follows allegations of a personal affair with Alice Huang, questions over chip export controls to China, and multiple Department of Justice probes, leading to a significant drop in Nvidia stock and political debate in the US. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p48#a261111p48), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/nvidia-stock-drops-jensen-huang-second-affair-report-2026-11), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-12/alleged-chinese-spy-at-center-of-nvidia-firestorm-is-in-beijing), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/elon-musk-hire-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-if-board-ousts-2026-11))

### Commerce Department finalizes AI remote access rule
The US Commerce Department is finalizing a rule to prevent Chinese AI firms from remotely accessing US chips and to block chip smuggling into China via data centers. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/commerce-department-finalizing-long-awaited-ai-remote-access-rule), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p53#a261111p53))

### Fractile raises $720M for AI chips
UK-based AI chip startup Fractile raised $720 million in a Series C round at a $7 billion valuation to develop faster inference hardware for agentic AI. ([Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/start-ups/uk-ai-chips-start-up-fractile-raises-720m-at-7bn-valuation), [Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/uk-ai-chip-start-up-fractile-raises-720m-at-7bn-valuation))

### Agile Robots raises $500M led by SoftBank
Munich-based robotics company Agile Robots raised $500 million in a round led by SoftBank, valuing the firm at $8.5 billion to expand its humanoid and mobile robot development. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-12/softbank-backs-agile-robots-in-500-million-humanoid-push), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261112/p6#a261112p6), [Latest from Sifted](https://sifted.eu/articles/softbank-leads-500m-round-for-agile-robots/))

### Chinese AI firms seek overseas Nvidia compute capacity
Chinese AI companies are rushing to rent Nvidia-powered computing capacity at overseas data centers amid fears of tighter US export controls and the Jensen Huang spy scandal. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261112/p4#a261112p4), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/chinese-ai-firms-seek-overseas-nvidia-capacity-amid-export-control-fears/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/chinese-ai-firms-seek-overseas-nvidia-computing-3809667))

### Alice Huang barred from Singapore entry and returns to China
Alice Huang, founder of Megaspeed, was barred from entering Singapore and has returned to Beijing, where she is reportedly living with the knowledge of security officials. Her firms have invested in DeepSeek, and the situation has become a focal point in the broader Nvidia and Jensen Huang scandal. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p50#a261111p50), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/12/thursday-briefing-what-we-do-and-dont-know-about-alice-huang-and-the-nvidia-affair), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-12/singapore-says-warns-alice-huang-lacks-evidence-of-offenses), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/alice-huangs-companies-invested-deepseek-promising-nvidia-chips))

### Norwest announces $4 billion AI-focused investment fund
Norwest announced Norwest 18, a $4 billion venture and growth equity fund that identifies AI as a key investment priority. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/norwest-pushes-deeper-into-ai-with-new-4b-fund/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/norwest-announces-4b-fund-with-ai-among-its-investment-priorities/))

### Google opens pre-orders for Gemini-powered smart glasses
Google has opened pre-orders for its Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear, starting at $395, emphasizing privacy features and AI capabilities. ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/11/google-pushes-privacy-angle-as-gemini-powered-smartglasses-debut-starting-at-395/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-opens-pre-orders-for-gemini-powered-intelligent-eyewear/))
